boundary.message: The shore ends here. The ferry comes to the jetty.

content.outro: Out across the sound a lantern swings away from the far landing. The ferry is coming.
content.premise: A wet afternoon on a sandy shore. The ferry lies across the sound and only crosses when its bell is rung. The bell hangs in the ferry house at the end of the jetty, bolted in, and Nell Garrow, who keeps it, will not ring it alone: the last three times it rang, the dead came up out of the cove onto the spit across the water.
content.theme: One sandy shore in the rain: a plank jetty with a spruce rail running out over grey water to a small timber ferry house on piles, the ferry bell inside it, and a low spit of sand across the cove.
content.title: The Ferry Bell
